title: Home with a host: Rosa, the mode tabs on top and one wide card
problem: Home's Market tab says the same thing several times (the four ways to play are on the card and on the Play page; a mode's name and facts repeat), its cards are uneven, nothing on it moves after the opening and the shopkeepers are small circles. The owner asked for a friendlier landing page: one moving character, and cards you can swipe.
scope: The Market tab, top to bottom: fruit band (fruit straight on its colour), title with the profile chip and the gear in its own square, the mode tabs, Rosa and her bubble, one wide card, Play

Rosa as the host in every mode: full body, moving (walks in, sways, blinks, waves her price tag, taps her foot, hops and talks for a new line); a tap on her or her bubble gives another line; faint bunting and crates behind her
Her lines are chat and tips only; a mode's facts are on its card once
The cards: the mode's name with where you stand beside it; Daily and Sprint show the first customer beside a larger lorry and one line of rules; "Not played" is plain words by the date
"Custom match" becomes "Match" everywhere (tab, card, Play page, the game's own labels)
The Match card's four ways are tiles with pictures: a tile chooses, the chosen one is ticked and remembered, and Play names it ("Play · Computer") and opens that way's own page
A sideways swipe on the card changes mode, as the tabs do
Removed from Home's cards: the lines under the four ways, "your market, your way", the you-against-rivals rows, the Next goal line, the Daily's twist and League echo, the Sprint's week line
exclusions: No change to the rules, the balance, the computer players, the online messages or saves (rules version 20, protocol 5 unchanged)
The Stall and Rules tabs, the League, Daily and Sprint pages and the set-up pages are unchanged
The Play page stays in the game: "Start over" on a waiting Match still leads to it

acceptance.evidence: records OK, palette, lint, types, 1440 passed in 139 files (6 new: tests/host-words.test.ts and two in tests/home-cards.test.ts), build OK

acceptance.text: npm run test:e2e (0 leaks), with the scripts moved to the new routes (a tile, then Play)
acceptance.evidence: CI on pull request 42 (verify:full, run 46093480863): success, performance budget included. Locally every step passed with 0 leaks except the performance budget (245 and 230 ms against 200 ms on this machine)

acceptance.text: The Market tab fits one screen at 360x640, 390x844 and 320x568, and reads well at 1280x800
acceptance.evidence: Screenshots of the local game at each size; the tab does not scroll (scroll height equals the screen's at 390x844 and 320x568)

acceptance.text: In the browser: a swipe changes mode, a tile chooses and Play names and opens it, a tap on Rosa or her bubble gives another line, a waiting Match shows its day and cash with Continue and New game
acceptance.evidence: Local run at 360x640: swipe left to League and back; "Play · Quick Match" opened the Quick Match page; Rosa's lines changed on taps; "Day 1 of 10 · $10", Continue, New game; no console errors

acceptance.text: On a real phone: Rosa's movement is smooth and the swipe feels right
acceptance.evidence: No phone is available in this session; for the owner on the preview
